name: baseline-breaker
description: A top-down tennis brick-breaker in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No build step.

scripts.android: python3 stage.py && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: python3 stage.py && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: python3 stage.py && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: python3 stage.py && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
